title: Journal Club: Slaying the Sleeper Cells of Aging with CAR T

reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to the A16Z Journal Club.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the A16Z Journal Club. This is our podcast where we cover recent scientific advances, why they matter, and how to take them from proof of principle to practice. CART therapy is a groundbreaking medicine that uses engineered T cells to attack cancer.

key_points.text: It has revolutionized oncology, and today we're digging into new research using CART to treat a wide range of conditions.
key_points.evidence_quote: It has revolutionized oncology, and today we're digging into new research using CART to treat a wide range of conditions, including those related to aging.

key_points.text: CART stands for chimeric antigen receptor T cell.
key_points.evidence_quote: CART stands for chimeric antigen receptor T cell, and the basic idea is to create an immune cell that is programmed to target and destroy specific cells.

key_points.text: But until recently, CART have primarily been trained to go after cancer.
key_points.evidence_quote: But until recently, CART have primarily been trained to go after cancer.

key_points.text: But given the incredible attractability of these engineered T cells, new specificity can be encoded.
key_points.evidence_quote: But given the incredible attractability of these engineered T cells, new specificity can be encoded.
